reels.title: 100 bandar, 100 kele... kitne minute? 🐒

reels.title: Jungle ka heera kisne churaya? 💎

reels.title: Aadha talaab kab bhara? 🪷
reels.caption: Kamal roz double. Din 30 par poora talaab. Toh aadha kab? 😏

reels.title: Shahad chor ne khud ko pakadwa diya 🍯
reels.caption: Teen jawab. Ek chhoti si galti. Pakad paoge? 🕵️

reels.title: Ek sach, ek jhooth, sawaal sirf 1 🦜
reels.caption: Ek raasta ghar, ek magarmach ke paas. Kya poochoge? 🐊

reels.title: Hathini ke kitne bacche? 🐘

reels.title: Bhalu ka rang kya tha? 🐻
reels.caption: Dakshin, purab, uttar, aur wapas ghar. Rang kaise pata chala? 🤯

reels.title: Mendhak kitne din mein bahar aayega? 🐸

reels.title: 3 dibbe, teeno par galat label 📦
reels.caption: Sirf ek phal dekh kar sab theek karna hai. Kaunsa dibba khologe? 🥭

reels.title: Sabse aage wale ko apni topi kaise pata chali? 🎩

reels.title: Kela kitne ka hai? 🍌
reels.caption: Kul ₹110. Nariyal ₹100 mehenga. Pehla jawab aksar galat hota hai 😄

reels.title: 12 baje ghadi kitni der bajegi? 🕛
reels.caption: 6 baje: 6 ghante, 5 second. Toh 12 baje? ⏰

reels.title: 3 switch, 1 bulb, darwaza sirf 1 baar 💡
reels.caption: Andar jaakar kaise pata karoge kaunsa switch kiska? 🤔
